name: e-Tax Invoice
nameTh: ใบกำกับภาษีอิเล็กทรอนิกส์
description: Thai e-Tax Invoice preparation (ETDA ขมธอ. 3-2560, UN/CEFACT CII D16B): snapshots every tax invoice, credit note and debit note issued in Sales, builds the XML (ใบกำกับภาษี 388, ใบแจ้งหนี้/ใบกำกับภาษี T02, ใบเพิ่มหนี้ 80, ใบลดหนี้ 81) with satang-exact totals, signs it XAdES-BES with the company's own digital certificate (.p12, password never stored), tracks delivery status (draft → generated → signed → sent by e-Tax Invoice by Email or a service provider — recorded by the user; this module never submits to the Revenue Department or ETDA), cancels documents that were never sent, and prepares replacement tax invoices for delivered ones with wrong non-amount data (ETDA purpose codes TIVC01/TIVC02/TIVC99).

permissions.label: ดูใบกำกับภาษีอิเล็กทรอนิกส์และดาวน์โหลด XML
